GenericTalentFollowThrough.name: Follow Through
GenericTalentFollowThrough.description: After using an Ability, your next Basic Attack within 6 seconds deals 40% additional damage.

ThrallEchooftheElements.description: Quest: Kill Minions or Heroes within 2 seconds of hitting them with Chain Lightning. ThrallCrashLightning.name: Crash Lightning
ThrallCrashLightning.description: Quest: Hit at least 2 Heroes with a single use of Chain Lightning. Upon dying, lose 4 stacks. Gained rewards cannot be lost. ThrallMaelstromWeapon.description: Quest: Basic Attack Heroes while Windfury's Movement Speed bonus is active. Reward: After hitting 25 Heroes, increase the Movement Speed bonus of Windfury to 40% and Thrall's Basic Attacks deal 40 additional damage. ThrallFeralResilience.name: Feral Resilience
ThrallFeralResilience.description: Heroes damaged by Feral Spirit grant 4 stacks of Frostwolf Resilience and 2 stacks of Feral Resilience, granting 75 Physical Armor against the next incoming Hero Basic Attack. Stacks are consumed on the next cast of Feral Spirit.

ThrallFrostwolfPack.name: Frostwolf Pack
ThrallFrostwolfPack.description: Quest: Hit 6 Heroes with Feral Spirit. Progress is lost on death and when Thrall fails to hit a Hero. Reward: Reduce the cooldown and Mana cost of Feral Spirit by 50%.

ThrallMasteryManaTide.name: Mana Tide
ThrallMasteryManaTide.description: Frostwolf Resilience restores 15 Mana and reduces Basic Ability cooldowns by 0.5 seconds.

ThrallMasteryRollingThunder.name: Rolling Thunder
ThrallMasteryRollingThunder.description: Passive: Chain Lightning bounces an additional time. For 8 seconds after hitting an enemy with Chain Lightning, Thrall's next Basic Attack against them grants a stack of Frostwolf Resilience. ThrallAncestralWrath.name: Ancestral Wrath
ThrallAncestralWrath.description: Activate to consume 8 stacks of Ancestral Wrath, damaging a target enemy Hero for 15% of their maximum Health over 3 seconds, and healing Thrall for 150% of the damage dealt. Gain 1 stack of Ancestral Wrath every time Frostwolf Resilience activates.

ThrallElementalAssault.name: Elemental Assault
ThrallElementalAssault.description: After using an Ability, Thrall's next Basic Attack within 4 seconds deals 45% more damage.

ThrallHeroicAbilitySundering.name: Sundering
ThrallHeroicAbilitySundering.description: After 0.5 seconds, sunder the earth in a long line, dealing 290 damage and shoving enemies to the side, Stunning them for 1 second.

ThrallHeroicAbilityEarthquake.name: Earthquake
ThrallHeroicAbilityEarthquake.description: After 0.5 seconds, summon a massive Earthquake that pulses every 4 seconds. Each pulse lasts 2 seconds, Slowing all enemies in the area by 50%, and deals 50 damage to enemy Heroes. Does 3 pulses.

ThrallMasteryGraceOfAir.name: Grace Of Air
ThrallMasteryGraceOfAir.description: Windfury attacks grant twice as many stacks of Frostwolf Resilience.

ThrallMasteryFrostwolfsGrace.name: Frostwolf's Grace
ThrallMasteryFrostwolfsGrace.description: Frostwolf Resilience can be activated to instantly heal. This healing is increased by up to 100% based on Thrall's missing health.

ThrallSpiritShield.name: Spirit Shield
ThrallSpiritShield.description: Every 45 seconds, gain 70 Spell Armor against the next enemy Ability and subsequent Abilities for 4 seconds. Frostwolf Resilience reduces this cooldown by 10 seconds. Can be toggled to allow or prevent this talent from triggering automatically.

ThrallMasteryTempestFury.name: Tempest Fury
ThrallMasteryTempestFury.description: The final strike of Windfury hits 3 times for 75% normal damage. These hits do not provide quest progress.

ThrallThunderstorm.name: Thunderstorm
ThrallThunderstorm.description: Chain Lightning Slows the primary target by 8% for 2 seconds when used on Heroes. ThrallAlphaWolf.name: Alpha Wolf
ThrallAlphaWolf.description: For 3 seconds after a Hero is hit by Feral Spirit, Thrall's Basic Attacks against them deal an additional 3% of the target's maximum Health as damage. Passive: Increase the duration of Feral Spirit's Root to 1.5 seconds.

ThrallMasteryWorldbreaker.name: Worldbreaker
ThrallMasteryWorldbreaker.description: Lower the cooldown of Sundering by 40 seconds. After Sundering impacts, it leaves behind an impassable rift, blocking unit movement for 3 seconds.

ThrallMasteryEarthenShields.name: Earthen Shields
ThrallMasteryEarthenShields.description: Allies within the Earthquake area gain a Shield equal to 15% of their maximum Health each pulse. This shield lasts 4 seconds.

ThrallElementalMomentum.name: Elemental Momentum
ThrallElementalMomentum.description: Basic Attacks reduce Thrall's Basic and Heroic Ability cooldowns by 0.25 seconds, tripled against Heroes.

GenericTalentNexusBlades.name: Nexus Blades
GenericTalentNexusBlades.description: Basic Attacks deal 20% more damage and Slow enemy Movement Speed by 20% for 1 second.

ThrallWindRush.name: Wind Rush
ThrallWindRush.description: Activate to immediately teleport to a target location and gain Windfury.
